summary: Frontend permissions hook was updated to make Images editable for everyone, and backend was updated to use a migration module on deploy; however, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that backend setImage/clearImage authorization was changed as required, nor that Media Manager UI copy and non-admin submit behavior were updated per the acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update backend image publishing/clearing authorization so that ANY caller (including non-admin users) can publish and clear Image Memory slots (indices 0–42), while keeping Hero/Video/Song admin-only and preserving invalid-index errors.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff is truncated before any setImage/clearImage/setHeroBackground/setVideo/setBackgroundSong authorization logic is shown, so there is no explicit evidence that the image allowlist restriction was removed for publishing/clearing or that admin-only restrictions for hero/video/song remain enforced with clear authorization errors.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no visible setImage/clearImage or related auth checks)

missing_requirements.requirement: Update Media Manager permissions logic so Images tab is editable for all visitors, while Hero/Videos/Song remain admin-only; ensure Images tab no longer shows old lock text; non-admin submit publishes only image changes and shows errors in English without closing.
missing_requirements.reason: While canEditImages is set to true for everyone, the diff summary does not show the MediaManager UI changes needed to remove/replace the prior lock messaging on Images, nor does it show the submit flow logic ensuring non-admins only attempt image operations and keep the dialog open on errors.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update Media Manager UI copy to tell users they can choose images from phone gallery or Google Drive via the device file picker (no separate Google login).
missing_requirements.reason: No explicit new instruction/copy about selecting from 'Photos' or 'Google Drive' via the system picker is visible in the provided truncated MediaManager diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a backend migration module and wired it into the actor deployment using `(with migration = Migration.run)`.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not request any data migration work; additionally, the constraints emphasized keeping backend logic changes in `backend/main.mo`, but this change adds a new backend file and imports it.

hallucinated_features.description: Added frontend backend-error translation logic producing standardized English error titles/messages.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested as a feature; while it may help meet the 'errors shown in English' acceptance criteria, the BuildRequest did not ask for a new translation layer as a discrete addition.
